headline: Increase of Up to 13% in Minimum Wage Expected for 2027
summary: Businesses and consultants expect the general minimum wage to rise 12% to 13% in 2027, taking it above 10,800 pesos a month. A smaller adjustment is expected in the northern border zone.
why: Mexico's minimum wage sets a floor for pay across the economy, so changes feed into labor costs, consumer spending and inflation.
original_headline: Prevén incremento de hasta 13% al salario mínimo en 2027
